name: thinloop
description: Simplify complex development with deep discovery, risk-adaptive Web experience design, reliable delivery, and concise experiential knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Discovery, UIUX, delivery, and proven knowledge
interface.longDescription: Clarify consequential product decisions, design Web experiences at the lightest useful fidelity, keep implementation scoped and evidence-backed, and preserve proven development experience without a fixed pipeline.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SCD Discovery when product decisions are open, SCD UIUX when a Web experience needs design, SCD Dev Loop for evidence-backed implementation, and SCD Knowledge only when I explicitly ask to capture or retrieve proven experience.
